description: This file defines the 'Worksheet' class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, encompassing worksheet properties, cell management, styling, merging, splitting, and various worksheet-specific operations. It is a crucial component of the spreadsheet handling functionality, managing cells, dimensions, charts, styles, and worksheet behavior.

classes.name: Worksheet
classes.description: Represents a worksheet within a spreadsheet, providing methods to manage cells, styles, dimensions, merging, splitting, charts, and various worksheet properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Worksheet instance, setting its parent (spreadsheet), title, default dimensions, and internal collections.

methods.name: disconnectCells
methods.description: Unsets all cells in the worksheet, allowing the worksheet object to be unset without memory leaks.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks when the worksheet is destroyed, including clearing calculation cache and disconnecting cells.

methods.name: getCellCollection
methods.description: Returns the collection of cells associated with the worksheet.

methods.name: getInvalidCharacters
methods.description: Returns the array of characters invalid in sheet titles.

methods.name: checkSheetCodeName

methods.name: checkSheetTitle
